limitations: This is an in-sample replay of one already selected locklet, not a detection study.
The candidate CFO and lower-edge hypothesis remain fixed at their persisted values.
The parabolic curve is inferred from three integer score cells; it is not a direct fractionally shifted template evaluation.
Overlapping 20 ms windows remain statistically dependent at the 10 ms stride.

method.score: conditioned exact GLRT-64 at fixed persisted acquired CFO
sensitivity_interpolators: three-cell parabola in ordinary exact-minus-control margin
